run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate slab placements and write vasp input files
precompute_slabs: precompute bulk slab surfaces and save them to a directory for later use
generate_heuristic_placements: generate heuristic adsorbate placements on a slab surface using the heuristic mode
generate_random_placements: generate random adsorbate placements on a slab surface with configurable rotation modes
write_surface: write vasp input files and metadata for a specified slab surface to disk
